app.name: SocialPrune
start.description: Go through your old X posts and Instagram comments, decide what should go, and get a list to delete it on the platform yourself.
start.privacy: SocialPrune reads your export in this browser. It has no server that could receive it.
gate.unavailable.title: This window cannot open real exports
gate.unavailable.body: SocialPrune opens an export only when it can block network access for the code that reads it, and this window does not allow that. Some private windows do this. Open SocialPrune in a normal window, or use the command line version. The demo works here.
gate.framed.title: Open SocialPrune directly
gate.framed.body: SocialPrune opens exports only when it is not embedded in another page. Open socialprune.github.io/socialprune directly.
guide.pending.body: The export steps have not been checked yet. No platform instructions are shown until that check is complete.
demo.banner: Demo with invented posts. The suggestions are examples written for this demo. No classifier produced them.
demo.pending: The review demo comes with the next part of this app. You can already check the app's offline and language settings.
import.parts: You can choose several files if your export came in parts.
import.check: Your export stays on this device. Want to check? Turn off your Wi-Fi now. SocialPrune keeps working.
import.reading: Reading your export... {count, number} {count, plural, one {entry} other {entries}} so far.
import.complete: {count, number} {count, plural, one {entry received} other {entries received}}.
import.cancelled: The import was cancelled. Its partial entries were discarded.
import.error: The archive could not be read. Choose another export and try again.
settings.foundation: Workspace settings arrive with the review. Language and appearance apply to this browser now.
privacy.read: SocialPrune reads the ZIP files you choose on this device. It does not send export data to a server.
privacy.network: Your browser loads this app from GitHub Pages. GitHub Pages logs visitors' IP addresses. Loading the app is network traffic; export content is not sent.
privacy.storage: Browser storage can be cleared. Another site under the same socialprune.github.io origin would share its storage. Keep a backup when the review becomes available.
privacy.agent: With the command line version, you may choose to share entries with an agent. Their full text then goes to that agent's model provider. Software running as your computer's user is outside what SocialPrune can control.
update.ready: A new version of SocialPrune is ready.
update.failed: The update could not start because a tab has not finished its work. Try again after the import stops.
workspace.storageError: The browser could not store this review. Download a backup before trying again.
review.title: Review
review.mediaCount: {count, number} {count, plural, one {image or video} other {images or videos}}, not shown here
review.mediaDetail: This post has {count, number} {count, plural, one {image or video} other {images or videos}}. SocialPrune does not show them. Open the post on X to see them.
review.noSuggestions: No suggestion for this entry. Read it and decide what you want to do with it.
review.likesValue: {count, plural, =-1 {Likes: unknown} one {# like} other {# likes}}
review.exportEngagement: Engagement figures describe the export, not the current platform counts.
review.selected: {count, number} {count, plural, one {entry selected} other {entries selected}}
review.total: {count, number} {count, plural, one {entry in this view} other {entries in this view}}
review.storageError: The browser could not save your review. Download a backup before trying again.
review.markNotice: {count, number} {count, plural, one {decision saved} other {decisions saved}}. Nothing was deleted on the platform.
review.undoNotice: {count, number} {count, plural, one {entry changed} other {entries changed}}. {skipped, number} {skipped, plural, one {entry was skipped because its state changed} other {entries were skipped because their state changed}}.
review.noHistory: There is no action to reverse.
review.historyIntro: These are the decisions recorded on this device. Undo changes the record, not anything on the platform.
review.keyboardIntro: Single-letter shortcuts work only while the review grid has focus, never in a text field.
review.tip: Tip: ↑ ↓ to move, M to mark for deletion, ? for all keys.
review.gridHelp: Use arrow keys to focus an entry, Space to select it, and Enter for details. Focusing or selecting does not change a decision.
review.keySelect: Select or deselect the focused entry
review.keyClose: Return to the list or close a dialog
review.keyDecide: Mark, keep, later or return to undecided
review.notSaved: Not saved. Your last change could not be stored.
review.otherTab: The entries changed. This view has been refreshed.
review.filtersActive: Filters are active in this view.
review.noResults: No entries match these filters. Clear them to see the rest.
review.allDecided: Every entry in this account has a decision.
review.templateOld: Older than two years without engagement
bulk.title: {action} for {count, number} {count, plural, one {entry} other {entries}}?
bulk.counts: {count, number} {count, plural, one {entry will change} other {entries will change}}. {unchanged, number} {unchanged, plural, one {entry stays unchanged} other {entries stay unchanged}}.
bulk.overwrite: Also include the {count, number} {count, plural, one {entry I already chose to keep or mark} other {entries I already chose to keep or mark}}
bulk.platformNotice: Nothing is deleted on the platform. You delete marked entries yourself with the click list.
bulk.sample: First {count, number} {count, plural, one {entry in this preview} other {entries in this preview}}
bulk.stale: Some of these entries changed since the preview. Here is the new preview.
bulk.expired: This preview expired. Here is a new preview of the current entries.
import.deflate64: SocialPrune does not read {file} in the browser, because the ZIP compresses it with Deflate64. Extract it with your computer's own tool and open the folder, or use the command line version.
import.encrypted: {file} is protected with a password, and SocialPrune does not ask for passwords. Extract it with the tool that set the password and open the folder.
import.unknown: SocialPrune does not recognize this file. Choose the ZIP file or folder from your X or Instagram data export.
import.html: This is the HTML version of your Instagram export. SocialPrune needs the JSON version. Request a new export and choose JSON as the format.
review.moreSources: {count, number} more {count, plural, one {suggestion source} other {suggestion sources}}
bulk.selectionCount: {inView, number} of {requested, number} selected {requested, plural, one {entry is in this view} other {entries are in this view}}. {notInView, number} are outside it and will not change.
bulk.selectionLimit: A custom selection can include at most 10,000 entries. Use Select all in this view for a larger view.
review.replyReference: Reply to entry {id}, as recorded in the export. SocialPrune does not have the post this replies to.
bulk.suggestedFilter: Current suggestions with risk Medium or High, and decisions Undecided or Later
review.replyHandle: Replying to @{handle}. SocialPrune does not have the post this replies to.
review.commentReference: The post this comment is on is not part of your export.
